text: {"lessons":["Holding is still a decision: my account fell 10.6% from period 1 to period 5 even though I never traded.","The rebound in period 3 didn't prevent further losses, so I won't treat one good month as a sign that the decline is over.","Before buying or selling after a sharp move, I'll check what drove it and whether my exposure still fits the losses I can tolerate."]}
